name: LG Laundry Specialist
tagline: Tell it what needs washing and it starts the right cycle on your LG machine
description: Say what is going in the drum in ordinary language: muddy sports kit, a delicate jumper, towels that need a hot wash. It works out which cycle on your LG ThinQ washer or dryer matches, then starts it. Enable Remote Start once at the appliance; after that, turning requests into settings is its job, not yours.
author: Bwilson
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
